item.title: Stormwater directorate objects to Transport Malta's Bormla car park plan
item.description: The Coastal and Stormwater Directorate has formally objected to Transport Malta's proposal to replace the historic reservoir outside St Helen's Gate in Bormla with a new reservoir and car park. The objection warns the project would compromise an existing rainwater-harvesting facility and destroy significant remains of a mid-19th century industrial reservoir.
item.content:encoded:
The Coastal and Stormwater Directorate has formally objected to Transport Malta's proposal to replace the historic reservoir outside St Helen's Gate in Bormla with a new reservoir and car park. The objection warns the project would compromise an existing rainwater-harvesting facility and destroy significant remains of a mid-19th century industrial reservoir.

Sources: Malta Today
